ground_truth_disclaimer: NREL PVDAQ System 2105 telemetry lacks operator maintenance logs, work orders, or labeled fault logs. True physical Precision, Recall, False Alarm Rate, and fault-detection accuracy CANNOT be calculated. All alarms represent unconfirmed statistical deviations or heuristic rule flags.
environmental_novelty_definition: Environmental novelty is defined as multivariate out-of-distribution density identified by Isolation Forest across (GHI, Temperature, Wind_Speed, Effective_GHI). Disagreements between detectors represent statistical feature novelty, NOT independently validated severe meteorological events.
statistical_residual_vs_physical_fault: Statistical residual exceedances mark timestamps where actual output falls >2.5 sigma below the XGBoost expectation. While consistent with operational degradation, soiling, grid curtailment, or sub-string trips, they remain unconfirmed without field verification.
